title: An interpretable deep learning method for early hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis on multiphase CT
abstract: arXiv:2610.29616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Early diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma is critical to preserve access to curative treatment options. The Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) provides a standardized framework for non-invasive diagnosis on multiphase computed tomography, based on major visual imaging features. However, these features may be difficult to assess consistently, particularly in small liver lesions. We developed dLI-RADS, an interpretable artificial intelligence method designed to estimate the probability of hepatocellular carcinoma from multiphase computed tomography images of manually segmented liver lesions, while remaining aligned with LI-RADS-related imaging concepts. dLI-RADS combines neural network-derived predictions with handcrafted quantitative imaging measurements reflecting LI-RADS major features and integrates these inputs using logistic regression. translated_title: 一种用于多期CT早期肝细胞癌诊断的可解释深度学习方法
translated_abstract: 肝细胞癌的早期诊断对于保留获得根治性治疗选择的机会至关重要。肝脏影像报告和数据系统（LI-RADS）提供了一种基于主要视觉影像特征、在多期计算机断层扫描（CT）上进行无创诊断的标准化框架。然而，这些特征可能难以被一致地评估，尤其是在较小的肝脏病变中。我们开发了dLI-RADS，这是一种可解释的人工智能方法，旨在从手动分割的肝脏病变的多期CT图像中估计肝细胞癌的概率，同时与LI-RADS相关的影像概念保持一致。dLI-RADS将神经网络得出的预测与反映LI-RADS主要特征的手工定量影像测量相结合，并使用逻辑回归对这些输入进行整合。在这项多中心回顾性研究中，多期CT检查的患者……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为dLI-RADS的可解释人工智能方法，将神经网络预测与反映LI-RADS主要特征的手工定量影像测量相结合，通过逻辑回归整合，从多期CT图像中估计肝细胞癌概率，实现了与LI-RADS影像概念对齐的可解释早期诊断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes dLI-RADS, an interpretable AI method that combines neural network predictions with handcrafted quantitative imaging measurements reflecting LI-RADS major features via logistic regression, to estimate hepatocellular carcinoma probability from multiphase CT images in a manner aligned with LI-RADS imaging concepts.
